prompt: Square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of Navagunjara, divine nine-component form of Vishnu/Krishna. ONE unified creature in clear three-quarter side view. EXACTLY these nine animal parts: red ROOSTER HEAD with comb and beak; iridescent blue PEACOCK NECK; white BULL FRONT CHEST and prominent shoulder HUMP; tawny LION WAIST and rump; one long SNAKE TAIL; one TIGER front leg with striped fur and paw on ground; one ELEPHANT rear leg with gray thick skin and round foot on ground; one HORSE rear leg with slender dark leg and single hoof on ground; the FOURTH limb is one raised HUMAN ARM holding a pink LOTUS. Thus only THREE legs contact ground and one human arm is raised. All parts blend seamlessly into one coherent body, all nine parts and three feet plus hand visibly distinguishable. Tail is snake, not feathered. No peacock tail, no extra limbs, no riders, no wings, no multiple heads. Full body comfortably inside square on forested Odisha hilltop. Aura awe-inspiring sacred cosmic mystery and majestic divine revelation, soft gold light against blue twilight, reverent not horror monster. Painterly natural textures, no text or watermark.
